headline: Nasdaq-100 enters correction territory amid mounting artificial intelligence concerns
summary: The Nasdaq-100 index experienced a sharp decline, entering its third correction of the year as worries surrounding artificial intelligence intensified.
why: The Nasdaq-100 is a major stock market index tracking 100 of the largest non-financial companies listed on the Nasdaq, heavily weighted toward technology and AI leaders.
